papers.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
papers.desc: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation.

papers.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
papers.desc: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer.

papers.title: CADMAGEDDON: High-Fidelity CAD Reconstruction with Local Inference
papers.desc: CAD practitioners often work with proprietary parts that they are unwilling to share with external services.

papers.title: VisualArtifactSpec 1.0: Evaluating Visual Artifacts under Task Specifications
papers.desc: Visual artifact tasks test agents' ability to translate task specifications and source materials into outputs that meet practical needs.

papers.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
papers.desc: A quantized model is usually judged by comparing it with its BF16 original, but that comparison changes more than the weights.

papers.title: DNeo: Your Parallel Draft Model Needs Better Target Feature Encoding
papers.desc: Speculative-diffusion decoding uses a small parallel drafter model to generate b draft tokens in one forward pass, which then undergo parallel verification via a larger target model.

papers.title: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
papers.desc: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training.

papers.title: MillBill: A Machining Agent with Geometric Feedback
papers.desc: Turning a CAD model into a machining program requires both process knowledge and geometric precision.

papers.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
papers.desc: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks.

papers.title: AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions
papers.desc: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code.

papers.title: M3OPD-Reasoner: An Open Recipe for Post-Training Multimodal Reasoning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) enables a single student to absorb the skills of several domain teachers by learning from its own generated responses.

papers.title: The novelty exposed: ablation, reproducibility and transparency in 40 technical reports of open-weight large language models (LLMs)
papers.desc: In 2025 alone, 48 new large language model (LLM) architectures were added to the Hugging Face transformers library, and many of them arrive with a technical report that presents the model as new.

papers.title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
papers.desc: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist.

papers.title: GameRealm: Grounding Visual Learning in Interactive Games
papers.desc: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision.

papers.title: PanDWM: Panoramic 4D Driving World Models
papers.desc: Driving world models usually generate videos from six pinhole cameras with separate optical centres and small overlaps, and must learn to keep these views consistent.
